verdict.reasoning: Internal tier, budget 3, allowance 4 with David's one-round grant now spent (roundsSpent 4) — this is a David gate, so the verdict is a recommendation, and it lands on a head round 4 already reviewed (sinceLastReview: 0 commits, head == lastReviewedCommit d8b62f4d). Neither open finding clears the internal bar: the record-delivery race (PRRT_kwDOUKOPKc6h93eS) is real — recordDelivery re-enumerates receipts and exit files at invocation rather than capturing what publishPage rendered — but it requires a dispatch to land in the seconds between the publish and the next line of the same step, and its worst outcome is a newly-added reminder being one round stale, not a destructive action, a false CI/Codex/threads receipt, or widened authority. The SKILL.md contradiction (PRRT_kwDOUKOPKc6h93eV) is verified against the diff and genuine, but it is prose in an agent contract — explicitly excluded from qualifying as a behavioral risk — and the step it muddies is enforced mechanically in three independent places (close-out exit 1, checkTranslations, checkMerge), so an agent misled by it is still refused. Rounds 2 and 4 have now produced four findings in one family — that the marker cannot prove the account reached David — which is the irreducible ceiling the code itself names, and hardening a mistake-catcher against its own operator is the #7 shape the threat model in this very record tells me to decline.
